## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing effect.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Printer/profile support
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build/CI
- [ ] Refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build:packages`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Docker image builds and starts
- [ ] Documentation updated, if behaviour or support changed
- [ ] No secrets, uploaded models or converted files committed

## Conversion notes

For conversion changes, describe what is preserved, replaced or dropped, and
which printer/source combinations were tested.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, include before/after screenshots.
